messages:
Ana: Ran a wavefront canary replay for raven-lite int8. Observed ~2.3% increase in funcall schema failures vs baseline.
Sam: Can you paste a sample failure? rough time/window?
Ana: 1749994980-1749995000 window. Example payload from logs:
Dmitri: ```
Expected: {"tool": "lookup_price", "args": {"sku": "ABC-123", "country": "US"}}
Actual   : {"tool": "lookup_price", "args": "sku:ABC-123 country:US"}
``` 
Dmitri: So funcall got serialized into a freeform string — parser choked downstream.
Katie: My hunch: int8 quantized runtime + kvprefix merging changes tokenization boundaries for small tables. Seen similar on raven-lite earlier but at lower rate.
Sam: Any correlation with seq len or prefix bytes? KV cache usage?
Ana: Yes — 78% of failures had kv_prefix present and short sequence (<=32 tokens). Without kv_prefix failures drop to ~0.4%.
eval-bot: Canary replay summary: baseline schema-fail-rate=0.9% | canary=3.2% | p95 latency diff +12ms | sample-size 5k
Katie: Can you rerun a replay with tokenization debug flags on? e.g. set ENV DEBUG_TOKENIZER=1 and dump token spans for calls.
Dmitri: Will run a minimal repro: quant int8 runtime + kvprefix enabled vs disabled, collect tokenizer spans + model logits for tail tokens.
Ana: Also add a quick fix candidate: postprocess step that attempts to parse common "k:v" inline args heuristically, to reduce customer impact while we root-cause.
Sam: Can you share the CLI used? I'll spin up a dedicated canary shard.
Dmitri: CLI:
```
redwood-replay --canary raven-lite-int8 --range 1749994980-1749995100 --dump-json --env DEBUG_TOKENIZER=1
```
Katie: I'll instrument the parser to emit the failure fingerprint (truncated string + token ids) so we can cluster similar meltdowns.
Ana: Filing follow-up: create jira WAVE-312 with steps: repro, token-dump diff, parser-fingerprint clustering, heuristic-postprocess PR. Assigning Dmitri/Katie. @Sam please hold canary shard for repro.
Sam: ack. I'll block the shard and run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Posting dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/canary/wavefront/1749995000
Ana: Thanks all. If postprocess reduces visible failures we can rollback canary and open a patch for the quant runtime. :thumbsup:
Katie: I'll post results in this thread when token diffs are in.
eval-bot: Note: alert routed to eng-ml oncall as of 1749995590
